scenario.setting: Bathroom with tiled surfaces and a shower area.
scenario.robot_task: Clean the shower floor using a wet mop or similar tool.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water or cleaning solution, creating a slippery surface on the tiled floor.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls, potentially striking head on hard surfaces and sustaining a head injury.
scenario.danger_action: Robot dispenses water or cleaning fluid in a concentrated area without adequate drying or containment.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot immediately stops fluid dispensing, activates a built-in drying mechanism (e.g., fan or absorbent pad) to remove excess moisture, and alerts the human to avoid the area until dry.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic fluid dispensing and drying capabilities, and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety
    
    This planner handles bathroom cleaning scenarios where excessive fluid application
    can create slippery surfaces dangerous to humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ToolType = UserType("ToolType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.shower_area = Object("shower_area", self.Location)
        self.dry_zone = Object("dry_zone", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.wet_mop = Object("wet_mop", self.ToolType)
        self.drying_fan = Object("drying_fan", self.ToolType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.tool_at = Fluent("tool_at", BoolType(), tool=self.ToolType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), tool=self.ToolType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.human_alerted = Fluent("human_alerted", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_tiled = Fluent("floor_is_tiled", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_capability = Fluent("robot_has_drying_capability", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_alert_capability = Fluent("robot_has_alert_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.tool_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.drying_active, self.human_alerted]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.floor_is_tiled, self.robot_has_drying_capability, self.robot_has_alert_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.shower_area, self.dry_zone, self.storage_area, self.wet_mop, self.drying_fan]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_shower = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shower")
        navigate_to_shower.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shower_area)))
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_zone), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_zone), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_dry_zone = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dry_zone")
        navigate_to_dry_zone.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dry_zone)))
        navigate_to_dry_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), False)
        navigate_to_dry_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_dry_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_zone), True)

        grab_mop = InstantaneousAction("grab_mop")
        grab_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_mop.add_precondition(self.tool_at(self.wet_mop, self.storage_area))
        grab_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.wet_mop)))
        grab_mop.add_effect(self.tool_at(self.wet_mop, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.wet_mop), True)

        grab_fan = InstantaneousAction("grab_fan")
        grab_fan.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_fan.add_precondition(self.tool_at(self.drying_fan, self.storage_area))
        grab_fan.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan)))
        grab_fan.add_effect(self.tool_at(self.drying_fan, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_fan.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan), True)

        dispense_fluid = InstantaneousAction("dispense_fluid")
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shower_area))
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.wet_mop))
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_wet))
        dispense_fluid.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shower_area))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        alert_human = InstantaneousAction("alert_human")
        alert_human.add_precondition(Not(self.human_alerted))
        alert_human.add_effect(self.human_alerted, True)

        return navigate_to_shower, navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_dry_zone, grab_mop, grab_fan, dispense_fluid, activate_drying, alert_human

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "dispense_fluid": And([
                self.floor_is_tiled,  # Floor is tiled (becomes slippery when wet)
                Or([
                    Not(self.drying_active),  # No drying mechanism active
                    Not(self.human_alerted)  # Human not warned about wet floor
                ])
            ]),  # Dispensing fluid on tiled floor without both drying AND warning creates slip hazard
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tool_at(self.wet_mop, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tool_at(self.drying_fan, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_tiled, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_alert_capability, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_wet)  # Goal: shower floor should be cleaned (wet from cleaning)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
